decisions.decision: Standardize Cloudflare deployment on Workers + Workers Static Assets, not Pages + Pages Functions
decisions.status: ACCEPTED (decision only -- implementation not yet authorized)
decisions.context: Two deployment architectures were configured simultaneously; live production evidence showed Workers was already what served traffic.
alternatives: Stay on Pages (would require migrating OFF what already works)
Defer (rejected -- the CI job was actively failing every run, needed a decision)
evidence: CF-C1 through CF-C4 (live production curl evidence)
counterevidence: audit/cloudflare-decision/counterevidence.md -- all 4 stress-test counterarguments evaluated, 3 failed to reverse, 1 partially survived (operational-simplicity cost of the hand-rolled entrypoint bypass)
tradeoffs: Workers requires manually maintaining functions/_middleware.js wiring instead of getting it free from the official wrangler pages functions build path
reversal_conditions: If Smile Savers' API surface grows beyond 2-3 flat endpoints, the hand-rolled routing in entrypoint.js becomes a real maintenance liability and the official compile-based path should be reconsidered
verification_plan: Implement implementation-contract.md's 3 required changes, then re-run the live curl checks from repo-vs-live.md and confirm headers now match

decisions.decision: Remove cloudflare/pages-action deploy jobs from GitHub Actions CI
decisions.context: The jobs failed on every single run this session (missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN), and targeted a deployment mechanism (Pages) that live evidence showed was not what was actually serving production.
alternatives: Fix the missing secret and keep the Pages deploy job (rejected -- would deploy to the wrong architecture per ADR-0001)

Convert to `wrangler deploy` (deferred -- Cloudflare's own Git integration already deploys automatically, confirmed via repeated successful bot comments on this PR; adding a redundant wrangler deploy step was judged unnecessary, not proven necessary)
evidence: job log confirming "Input required and not supplied: apiToken"
repeated successful "Deploying with Cloudflare Workers" bot comments on this PR after every push this session
Cloudflare Git integration docs (live-fetched): "will automatically deploy your code every time you push a change"
tradeoffs: CI no longer has an explicit, GitHub-Actions-visible deploy step or gate -- deployment success is now only observable via Cloudflare's own bot comment/dashboard, not a GitHub Actions check
reversal_conditions: If Cloudflare's automatic Git integration is ever disabled or misconfigured for this repo, a manual `wrangler deploy` CI step would need to be reinstated
verification_plan: Confirmed: next push after commit 296f6a3 produced a successful Cloudflare bot deploy comment with no corresponding pages-action CI failure
